strings.privacy.title: Eby'ekusifu
strings.privacy.description: Engeri pdff gy'ekwataako fayiro zo: tewali kawunti, tewali kiwandiiko ekiyimirizibwa, tewali bikuzibwa n'okutunda ebikwata ku ggwe.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff ezimbiddwa okusobozesa biwandiiko byo okuba ebyo. Gano ge gammwe mu bigambo ebyangu, ebaddwo bw'ozikozesa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Fayiro zo
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ziweerezebwa nga zikuumiddwa (HTTPS), zikolebwa bwazo, ne zigibwako bw'omala okulaba ebifulumiziddwa. Fayiro ennene ziyita mu kifo ky'ekiseera wansi w'erinnya eriganyuddwa ne zigibwako bw'omala okukola; okulongosa kw'obwannannyini kuggyawo buli ekisigaddewo mu ssaawa 24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Tewali kawunti, tewali bikwata ku ggwe
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff tesaba kwewandiisa, tewali email wadde kaadi ya bbanka. Biwandiiko byo tebisomebwa, tebisengejjobwa, tebisabanyizibwa wadde okukozesebwa okuyigiriza obwengu bw'abantu.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Okupima abagenyi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tubala abagenyi awatali kumenya mannya wadde kookisi (Vercel Web Analytics) okumanya ebikozesa ebisinga okugasa. Tewali bikuzibwa, tewali kukuza migendo.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kookisi
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kookisi emu, ey'okwewakira: ejjukira olulimi lw'olonze.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Okukuumira
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Omukutu gukuumibwa Vercel ku ssaabiiti mu Paris; okukyusa kwa Word, Excel ne PowerPoint kukolebwa Render mu Frankfurt. Bano bakwata fayiro okumala ekiseera ky'okukyusa kwokka.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Tukwatagane

strings.legal.terms.title: Amateeka g'okozesa
strings.legal.terms.description: pdff ya bwereere eri buli omu, wamu n'amakampuni n'abakulu b'eggwanga. Fayiro zo zibeera zo: tewali kisunsulwa oba okukuumibwa.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Amateeka gano galagira enkozesa yo eya pdff. Gimpi era gawandiikiddwa mu lulimi olwangu. Okukozesa omukutu guno kitegeeza nti ogakkirizza.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Ani alina pdff
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdff yakolebwa, n'etondebwa Mikailou Cedric Toure, omukozi w'ebyuma eby'omulembe mu New Brunswick, Canada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Olusa lwa bwereere olw'okozesa, eri buli omu
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdff ya bwereere, awatali kwewandiisa wadde okukoma ku biro, eri buli omu: abantu ssekinnoomu, abayizi, abasomesa, amakampuni, bitongole ebitali bya magoba, gavumenti mu Canada ne mu nsi zonna. Tewali kifo kyawudiziddwa kulina kusasula, kubanga tewali ssente zisaba. Fayiro z'ofulumya ze zo nnyini: tezirina bubonero bwonna wadde erinnya lya pdff.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Fayiro zo zonna, n'ezibikkiddwa ennyo
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Oyinza okukola ku fayiro zonna, n'ezibikkiddwa, kubanga pdff tesoma, tesunsula, tekweka wadde okugabana fayiro zo: zikolebwa bwemwa n'oluvannyuma ne ziggyibwawo. Ono mukama waazo era w'olina obuvunaanyizibwa okuba n'obuyinza bwazo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Ensibuko y'ebigambo by'ekikula n'okuziteeka ku mikutu gyo
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Ensibuko y'ebigambo by'ekikula eya pdff efulumiziddwa wansi w'olusa lwa MIT. Oyinza okugisoma, okugikebera, okugiteeka ku mikutu gyo (n'okuva mu kifo awatali mutimbagano), okugikyusa n'okugabana ku bwereere, kasita okumanya obwanannyini n'olusa lwabyo bikuumibwa.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Enkozesa entuufu
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Toyinza kukozesa pdff mu bikolwa ebimenya amateeka, okugezaako okwonoona omukutu (okuweereza fayiro ennyingi mu ngeri y'ekyama, okuyingira mu ngeri embi) oba okumenya ebyuma ebikugira. Enkula y'ebipimo n'obungi bwa fayiro bikuumira buli omu.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Obubikke bw'omukutu
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdff eweebwa ya bwereere. Eyinza okukyuka, okuyimirizibwa okuddaabiriza oba okuggalawo. Bulijjo kuuma fayiro zo enkolwa ennungi: pdff tekumako kika kyazo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Obuvunaanyizibwa n'okukakasa
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Omukutu guweebwa “nga bwe guli”, awatali kukakasa kwa ngeri yonna. Ng'amateeka bwe gaganya, omufulumya tavunaanyizibwa ku bizibu ebivaamu, okubuzaabuuza kw'ebitabo oba enkyusa etali ntuufu. Kebera fayiro z'ofulumya nga tonnazikozesa mu nsonga enkulu.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Obwanannyini bw'amagezi
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Erinnya lya pdff, akabonero kaayo n'ebigambo by'omukutu bya mufulumya; enkola eri wansi w'olusa lwa MIT nga bwe kyogeddwa waggulu. Amannya g'ebintu agajjukizibwa (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) ga bannyini bago.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Amateeka agafuga
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Amateeka gano gafugibwa amateeka g'Essaza lya New Brunswick n'amateeka g'eggwanga lya Canada agafuga ensonga zino. Kooti za New Brunswick ze zirina obuyinza, awatali kumenya mateeka g'eggwanga lyo g'ewewa ng'omuguzi.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Enkyukakyuka
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Amateeka gano gayinza okugaziwazibwa. Olunaku oluli waggulu ku lupapula lulaga enkyukakyuka enkolere; enkyukakyuka ekola ku bikolebwa oluvannyuma lw'okuteekebwawo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].title: Tukwatagane
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].text: Waliwo ekibuuzo ku mateeka gano? Tuwandiikire okuva ku lupapula lw'omulimu:
strings.legal.security.title: Obukuumi n'ebikwata ku fayiro
strings.legal.security.description: Kiki ekituuka ku fayiro zo ku pdff: okukolebwa kwazo okw'ekirooto, obutali kusunsulwa, okuziggyawo amangu, okubikkirira, okuterekebwa mu Yuropa, n'okuba n'obuyinza obuziteeka ku mikutu gyo.
strings.legal.security.intro: Kiki ekituuka ku fayiro zo, gy'ezikolebwa ne bwe zikuumibwa: kinyonyoddwa mu ngeri ennungi, eri abantu ssekinnoomu n'abakugu b'ebyuma.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Tewali fayiro zikuumibwa
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Fayiro zo zikolebwa bwemwa, ne ziggyibwawo amangu ddala nga ziweddwa oba ziweerezedwa. Tewali kikopi, tewali bkuumi, tewali byafaayo. Okusesema kw'ekiro okwa bulijjo kusangula fayiro zonna ezisigaddewo, mu lunaku oluddako ku lw'eggulo okusingayo.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Tewali kusunsula
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Tewali muntu asoma fayiro zo. Tezisunsulwa, tezigabanyizibwa wadde okukozesebwa okutendeka amagezi g'ebyuma. pdff terina akawunti, tewali bbuuliro ly'ebyamateeka wadde ebifaanana by'abakozesa.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Okubikkirira
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Buli kiggwa kyona kibikkiriddwa (HTTPS) era omukutu gukakamya okubikkirira ku buli kigenyi (HSTS). Ekyuma ekikuumi kizingira PDF zo ne AES-256; ekibibalo ky'olonda tekikeeberwako.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Awakolebwa fayiro zo
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Omukutu, ebikozesebwa bya PDF n'ebifaanana: Vercel, kifo kya data e Paris (Bufalansa, Omukago gwa Yuropa). Enkyusa za Word, Excel ne PowerPoint: Render, mu Frankfurt (Gyirimaani, Omukago gwa Yuropa). Fayiro ezisussa 4 MB: ebifo ebiseera ebya Vercel Blob, wansi w'erinnya eritalina makulu, ebiggyibwawo oluvannyuma lw'okukozesa.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Ebikuumi by'ebyuma
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Ebikwata ku bikuumi (HSTS, okuziyiza omukutu okuyingizibwa mu mpapula endala, obukuumi ku kukyaamu kwa fayiro), endagiriro z'ebiseera ezitayinza kukubwa, n'obuweereza bw'enkyusa obukkiriza naye nga bulina akabonero k'ekyama. Buli nkyukakyuka y'ebigambo ebigenda ku mikutu ekeberwa mu ngeri y'ekirooto (okugeza, okukebera ensobi) nga tennayingira mu nkola.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Ebyama n'amateeka agafuga
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff efulumizibwa mu New Brunswick era egondera amateeka ga Canada ag'obukuumi bw'ebikwata ku muntu (PIPEDA). Terokota ebikwata ku muntu ku bakozesa baayo: tewali akawunti, tewali email, tewali kikyukakyuka eky'okugoberera. Kyazimbibwa ku musingi gwayo gwe gumu n'ogwa Yuropa ogwa GDPR ne Mateeka 25 ag'e Quebec: okukendeeza data, obutaddamu kukozesa, okuggyawo oluvannyuma lw'okukola.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Ebitongole ebirina amateeka amakakali
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Singa amateeka go gaziyiza okuweereza fayiro ku kitongole ky'ebweru, teeka pdff ku mikutu gyo. Ebyuma byonna bya bwereere, bya buli omu era bikola n'obutaba na mutimbagano: tewali fayiro evva mu kifo kyo. Enkolagana y'okuteekawo eri ku lupapula lw'omulimu.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Okulabika obulungi
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Ensibuko y'ebigambo by'ekikula byonna ya bweru: ab'obukuumi bo basobola okukakasa buli ekyogeddwa wano.
strings.legal.security.sections[8].title: Tegeeza ku bukosefu
strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Olowooza nti ozudde obunafu mu bukuumi? Tegeeza mu ngeri y'ekyama okuva mu kitundu kya “Obukuumi” ku lupapula lw'omulimu:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Okuyamba abalina obulemu
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Okulongoosa okuyamba abalina obulemu ku pdff: WCAG 2.2 mutendera AA, amagezi agakoleddwa, obunafu obumanyiddwa n'engeri y'okutegeeza ku kizibu.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Buli omu alina okusobola okukozesa pdff, n'abazibe b'amaaso oba abalina obunafu mu maaso, abatawulira oba abalina obuzibu mu kuwulira, oba abalina obulemu mu mikono oba mu bwengula.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Omutendera ogulengera
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff egenderera okugondera Ebiragiro by'Okuyamba abalina obulemu ku Mutimbagano (WCAG) 2.2, mutendera AA, omutendera gw'ensi yonna ogwa W3C. Omutendera guno gulengera ebyetaago by'Ekitebe kya Canada ku Kuyamba ku Mutimbagano, omutendera gwa Yuropa EN 301 549 ne Section 508 mu Amerika, egenda ku WCAG 2.0 oba 2.1 mutendera AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Enkozesa y'ebiragiro
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff egondera mu kitundu WCAG 2.2 mutendera AA: obunafu obumanyiddwa bulagiddwa wansi. Ebigambo bino bisibukira ku kikebera ky'omunda ekyakolebwa nga October 2, 2026, nga tukozesa ebikozesebwa ebikola byokka (axe, Lighthouse) n'okukebera kw'abantu (ekyuma eky'okuwandiikira, okwawula langi, okukuza, okulangirira). Tewannabaawo kikebera ky'abweru ekyakolebwa.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Ebyakolebwa
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Omukutu gwonna gukola n'ekyuma eky'okuwandiikira, ng'alina omukutu gwa “Buuza ku bubaka” n'akabonero akalabika ku kintu ekiri ku mulimu. Okwawula langi z'ebigambo kuli waggulu wa 4.5:1. Ebitundu by'omulimu (okuyinika, ebyavaamu, ensobi) biweerezebwa eri abasoma abazibe. Entegeka ya fayiro eyinza okukyusibwa awatali kusikayo, n'ebifulumya. Omukutu gugondera entegeka y'ekyuma kyo “okukendeeza okutambula”: ebifaanana ebivugirira bisirikira ddala. Empapula zisigala nga zisomeka ku kukuza kwa 400% ne ku s celulares. Olulimi lwa buli lupapula lulangiriddwa, era Olwarabu lulagibwa okuva ku ddyo okudda ku kusozi.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Obunafu obumanyiddwa
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Awatali ntegeka eyo, ebifaanana eby'okusakaaza (omusingi, enkovu, enkyusa y'ebika) bivuga bulijjo; enkyusa esirikira ku kuteekaako omukono n'ekyuma eky'okuwandiikira. Enkovu ey'okusakaaza ku lupapula lw'awaka ekolebwa n'omwigo oba ngalo; ya kusakaaza, era Olukalala lw'ebika lw'eraga lujja n'ebigambo ku lupapula. Ennyumiza eyakyusiddwa n'ekyuma eyinza okuba n'obunafu. Okuggwako, okuyamba ku bulina obulemu ku fayiro eyifulumiziddwa kisinziira ku nsibuko: pdff teyongera bubonero bw'okuyamba ku PDF eterina.

strings.legal.accessibility.sections[4].text: Ekitundu ky'omukutu kizzaayo obuzibu gy'oli? Kinyonyole okuva ku lupapula lw'omulimu; twagala okuddamu mu naku 10 ez'omulimu n'okuwa ekifo eky'okukozesa singa okugatta kutwala ennaku eziwerako:
strings.legal.install.title: pdff eri ebitongole
strings.legal.install.description: Teeka pdff ku mikutu gya gavumenti yo oba kkampuni yo: ya bwereere, ya buli omu, era fayiro zo teziva mu kifo kyo.
strings.legal.install.intro: Gavumenti, amakampuni, amalwaliro, amasomero: teeka pdff mu nnyumba mu ddakiika n'okuumira ddala obuyinza bwa fayiro zo.
strings.legal.install.sections[0].title: Fayiro zo zibeera ku mutimbagano gwo
strings.legal.install.sections[0].text: Buli mulimu gukolebwa ku mikutu gyo, n'ebisigalira awatali mutimbagano. Tewali kikebera, tewali buweereza bw'abweru, tewali akawunti.

strings.legal.install.sections[1].text: Buli kyuma kya pdff, ebika ebisussa 40, LibreOffice ya Word, Excel ne PowerPoint, n'ennimi z'omukutu 160 zonna, mu kibanja kimu.
